ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this dispute cannot be settled on the record as it stands, so it goes to a human reviewer and no money moves now — the SGD 26.73 charged on TRP-02826 (EV-FARE-02826) is held rather than collected or refunded, and the SGD 11.00 contested is not awarded.

What the evidence shows. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02826) records a METERED trip charged SGD 26.73: base fare 3.80 + distance 10.50 + time 5.32 + platform fee 0.80, with surge multiplier 1.0 read from that same artifact, and no ERP, no tolls, no airport surcharge and no waiting fee. The booked optimal route is 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-02826). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02826) measures 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, 30.0% of optimal — which would pass both POL-RD-01 tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km).

Why the trace cannot carry that finding. The trace is impaired twice over. The admissibility pre-pass tagged it IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, and it is impaired for policy purposes too: it contains a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (19:39:44 to 19:41:24), above the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. No weighted independent source exists here: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02826) holds 0 messages; the fare breakdown records no ERP gantries and 0.00 of tolls; and the 18.2 km on the trip record is, by POL-RD-01's own terms, a rounded convenience copy of the same trace measurement, not an independent derivation. The rider's submission that the driver's one-line statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is the 'counterparty_statement admitting the route' is not accepted: it names no road, junction or segment, it places the vehicle on no corridor the optimal route does not use, and it asserts a cause (the navigation) rather than admitting the route; the driver's contrary submission on that point succeeds. With the trace impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration, POL-RD-10(3) fires and the case escalates.

The same result follows even if that statement were read as an admission. It carries no weight_multiplier and so cannot lift the confidence cap: the excess is carried only by the impaired trace at weight 0.6, so confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-10(1) would fire. Escalation is terminal either way and replaces any money outcome.

The driver's navigation excuse. No advisory covers this window: EV-ADVIS-02826-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, no payload). POL-RD-03 cannot be run in either direction, and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08; because no advisory identifier was cited, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

The rider's arithmetic, recorded but not awarded. Were the deviation established, POL-RD-02 would run: recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x the 1.0 surge on the fare breakdown + 0.80 = 20.42, giving a refund of 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND, above the 0.50 de minimis and at 23.6% of the charge well below the 90% full-refund share. I record that figure and do not award it. Nothing is added under POL-RD-09: there is no ERP, toll or surcharge line, so there is no double-count and no billing-integrity correction. No POL-RD-06 conduct referral arises: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 287 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, and the lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not be substituted for it.

What would resolve it. A POL-RD-07(ii) independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, an ERP gantry record placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a trip_record.actual_distance_km derived independently of this trace — together with the traffic advisory for the disputed window, which the bundle lacks. This ruling is provisional; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04, or ask that a person decide the dispute.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
